controls.label: TaskUIControls
controls.effect: Disable main/consult actions through Task owners with unchanged public shape.

assertions: Retained Task actions reject STALE_TASK after the cleanup boundary; no synthetic ContactEnded, wrap-up success or task:end. [Jest evidence: MR-05; T-008 services/task/{Task,TaskManager}.ts::postWelcomeStaleTaskDisabledControlsNoEnd.]

Old media acquisitions stop owned tracks before answer; host tracks and healthy calling line remain owned by their existing owners. [Jest evidence: MR-05; T-009 services/task/voice/WebRTC.ts::lateMediaDuringWaitAndAfterWipeStopsTracks, services/task/voice/WebRTC.ts::hostTracksUntouched and services/task/voice/WebRTC.ts::noAnswerEndOrHealthyDeregister.]

prohibited_states.requirement_quote: Cached state/aux/timestamps MUST change to Available only on backend acknowledgment.
Cleanup MUST NOT synthesize backend `ContactEnded`, successful wrap-up or `task:end`.
A late old-generation HTTP/WebSocket/media completion MUST NOT answer a call, install state or settle a replacement operation.
The client does not trigger platform failover or provision entitlement.
